title: Rivers Land Co. SEZ has repaid the facility from USD 50Mn to USD 38.5Mn. These have been fully funded from the respective businesses’ cash flows. 32

Group Debt Analysis and Centum’s Contingent Exposure
Centum has guaranteed Kes 5.2Bn of debt in respect of Centum Real Estate Ltd and Two Rivers Land Co. SEZ Ltd.
The outstanding exposures are adequately covered by the assets held in the respective subsidiaries.
